sentences.en: The map provides an overhead view of the entire city.
sentences.zh: 这张地图提供了整个城市的俯视图。

sentences.en: From the helicopter, we got an overhead view of the forest fire.
sentences.zh: 从直升机上，我们看到了森林火灾的俯视图。

sentences.en: The photographer took an overhead view of the beach for the magazine cover.
sentences.zh: 摄影师为杂志封面拍摄了海滩的俯视图。
